title: Bias In, Bias Out? Finding Unbiased Subnetworks in Vanilla Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method (BISE) for algorithmic bias mitigation through structural adaptation of neural networks. While fairness is an ethical consideration and the research utilizes datasets (like CivilComments) containing religious demographic identity labels, the core objective is the technical mechanism of subnetwork extraction rather than an evaluation of religion, faith, or specific moral frameworks.
